acceptance_evidence: AC1, a clean clone installs and builds in under five minutes: measured at 9 seconds from a fresh git clone with a frozen lockfile, and CI repeats it from a clean checkout every run
AC2, pnpm turbo test runs a passing test in each of the six packages: records 20 and 27 show 21 tasks successful across lint, typecheck, test and build for all six

AC3, apps/api answers GET /health with 200 and apps/worker processes a hello job from Redis: records 13 and 15, and records 26 and 27 after the race was fixed, all against real instances rather than mocks
AC4 as amended, CI runs lint, typecheck, test and build on every pull request: the node job with its Redis service container, green on this ticket's pull request
Carried in from SEEN-087: a commit changing packages/core rebuilt the graph, and the query for sumCents() returned its importer at record 19

findings.claim: The worker test was racy: waitUntilFinished waits for a completion event, and the events connection subscribed after the worker had already started
findings.failure_scenario: On a fast runner the job finishes before anything is listening, and the test waits for an event that has gone past. It timed out in CI and passed on the same commit in another run, so the suite would have been intermittently red for a reason nobody could reproduce locally
findings.resolution: The worker owns its events connection and exposes ready(), which resolves once both are subscribed, and the first test asserts readiness on its own. Returned to tdd at record 24, red at 25, green at 26, ten consecutive local runs with no failures

findings.claim: The documented human override did not exist: with a credential present, harness decide --answer still asked the model
findings.failure_scenario: A human disagreeing with a gate decision cannot record their judgement at all; the only ways past are lowering a threshold or rewriting the record until the model agrees, and the harness quietly becomes a machine that cannot be overruled
findings.resolution: A question a human has answered is no longer put to the model, while the other questions in the same stage still are. Test first: OverrideTest. Record 6 is the bug and record 8 is the override working

findings.claim: The solution_complete question asked whether a record names everything the change needs, a bar no large scaffold clears
findings.failure_scenario: Every large ticket stalls at the solution gate while its record grows to please a model rather than a reader, and the obvious escape is lowering the threshold, which is the one thing thresholds.toml exists to make visible
findings.resolution: The question now asks whether a competent implementer could build the change without stopping to ask something the record should have answered. Scores moved from 0.46 to 0.72 on the same record. Recorded in the note at record 5

findings.claim: Two harness changes were made inside a product ticket, which is scope this ticket does not own
findings.failure_scenario: Harness changes accumulate inside product tickets, where nobody reviewing the harness will look for them
findings.resolution: Both are recorded as notes in this journal, named in the Outcome and called out in their commits. They blocked this ticket, and deferring them would have meant either overriding a gate or padding a record

findings.claim: apps/api and apps/worker each compile every workspace package source into their own dist, so the same source is compiled more than once
findings.failure_scenario: Build times grow with the packages, and two apps could ship different compilations of the same source if their tsconfigs drift
findings.resolution: Accepted deliberately: it is what the ticket's no-publish-step decision costs, both apps extend the same base config, and turbo caches the result. Named in the solution record's risks

security_checklist: No secret in the diff: no credential, no token and no environment value in any file
New dependencies are named in the solution record and frozen in the lockfile, which CI installs with --frozen-lockfile
No live marketplace call in any test: the only network a test touches is a local Redis
No PII and no database: the trade-record schema is SEEN-008
No tool and no agent action: this ticket adds no policy-gate surface
